title: Q-BLIND-backup-restore: close the continuity blind spot backup-restore
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** grep:ops/blindspots/closed.jsonl::"id": "backup-restore"
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 7 within 168 h
**Status:** open

Why the owner would not know to ask: A backup never restored is a hope; the founder is one person.
Action: export D1 and KV to R2 on a clock and restore into a scratch database, recording the result. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.
